headline: IP Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Decline Y/Y on High Maintenance Costs
summary: International Paper beats adjusted earnings estimates despite a profit slump as maintenance outages hurt margins, while outlining third-quarter EBITDA targets and 2026 guidance.

headline: Avery Dennison Q2 Earnings Beat on Pricing & Productivity Gains
summary: AVY tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates, as pricing, productivity gains and volume growth lift margins, even as it flags second-half destocking risks.
